classes.notes: Fast, fragile, cheap to field. No vehicle ships in this class yet, so the target is a placeholder and nothing is checked against it.

The Eclipse is the only medium, and it now ships with a machine gun fitted, so the target is its fitted budget by definition — the weapon is about 28% of it, which is the share a weapon should be. It becomes a real constraint the moment a second medium is authored (D01-R27).

The Stampede is the only heavy, and it now ships with a cannon fitted. Same caveat as medium: one vehicle per class means the check confirms arithmetic rather than balance until the roster grows. The cannon is about 45% of the budget, which is what a HEAVY weapon on the one HEAVY mount should cost.
